SELECT h.reg_dttm, CASE h.trgt_tbl_nm WHEN 'TB_SY_CODE_GRP' THEN '그룹' WHEN 'TB_SY_CODE' THEN '코드' WHEN 'TB_SY_OPER_STD' THEN '운영 기준값' WHEN 'TB_SY_CODE_MAP' THEN '표기 대응' END AS kind,
CASE h.trgt_tbl_nm WHEN 'TB_SY_CODE' THEN COALESCE(g.code_grp_nm, split_part(h.trgt_key, ':', 1)) || ' · ' || split_part(h.trgt_key, ':', 2) || CASE h.chg_item_nm WHEN 'CODE_NM' THEN '' WHEN 'SORT_ORD' THEN ' · 순서' WHEN 'USE_YN' THEN ' · 사용' WHEN 'CODE_VAL' THEN ' · 값' WHEN 'UNIT_NM' THEN ' · 단위' WHEN 'ADD_VAL1' THEN ' · 추가값 1' WHEN 'ADD_VAL2' THEN ' · 추가값 2' WHEN 'ADD_VAL3' THEN ' · 추가값 3' WHEN 'DEL_YN' THEN '' ELSE '' END WHEN 'TB_SY_CODE_GRP' THEN COALESCE(g.code_grp_nm, h.aft_val, h.trgt_key) WHEN 'TB_SY_OPER_STD' THEN COALESCE(s.std_nm, split_part(h.trgt_key, ':', 1)) ELSE COALESCE(h.chg_item_nm, h.trgt_key) END AS item, CASE WHEN h.bfr_val IS NULL OR h.bfr_val = '' THEN '–' WHEN h.chg_item_nm IN ('USE_YN', 'DEL_YN') THEN CASE h.bfr_val WHEN 'Y' THEN '사용' WHEN 'N' THEN '사용 안 함' ELSE h.bfr_val END WHEN h.trgt_tbl_nm = 'TB_SY_OPER_STD' THEN h.bfr_val || COALESCE(s.unit_nm, '') ELSE h.bfr_val END AS before_value, CASE WHEN h.chg_item_nm = 'DEL_YN' AND h.aft_val = 'Y' THEN '삭제' WHEN h.chg_item_nm = 'USE_YN' THEN CASE h.aft_val WHEN 'Y' THEN '사용' WHEN 'N' THEN '사용 안 함' ELSE COALESCE(h.aft_val, '–') END WHEN h.aft_val IS NULL OR h.aft_val = '' THEN '–' WHEN h.trgt_tbl_nm = 'TB_SY_OPER_STD' THEN h.aft_val || COALESCE(s.unit_nm, '') || CASE WHEN split_part(h.trgt_key, ':', 2) ~ '^[0-9]{6}$' THEN ' (' || substr(split_part(h.trgt_key, ':', 2), 1, 4) || '-' || substr(split_part(h.trgt_key, ':', 2), 5, 2) || '부터)' ELSE '' END ELSE h.aft_val END AS after_value, COALESCE(u.user_nm, h.reg_user_id) AS reg_user_id FROM TB_SY_CHG_HIST h LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE_GRP g ON g.code_grp_id = CASE h.trgt_tbl_nm WHEN 'TB_SY_CODE' THEN split_part(h.trgt_key, ':', 1) WHEN 'TB_SY_CODE_GRP' THEN h.trgt_key END LEFT JOIN TB_SY_OPER_STD s ON h.trgt_tbl_nm = 'TB_SY_OPER_STD' AND s.std_cd = split_part(h.trgt_key, ':', 1) AND s.aply_bgn_ym = (SELECT min(x.aply_bgn_ym) FROM TB_SY_OPER_STD x WHERE x.std_cd = s.std_cd) LEFT JOIN TB_SY_USER u ON u.user_id = h.reg_user_id WHERE h.trgt_tbl_nm IN ('TB_SY_CODE_GRP', 'TB_SY_CODE', 'TB_SY_OPER_STD', 'TB_SY_CODE_MAP') ORDER BY h.reg_dttm DESC, h.hist_id DESC
